title: Retention reply: a Pro customer says it's too expensive
disclaimer: Uses the supplied fictional Lumen Cloud data (price_sheet.csv, policies.json). Drafts are written for the demo; preferences and retention beliefs are stakeholder inputs in preferences.json.
situation: A Pro customer of 18 months writes: 'This is getting too expensive, I'm thinking of canceling.' The AI support agent drafts replies; the gate decides whether each email may be sent.

drafts.text: I understand. Your Pro plan is $49 per month and we can't change pricing.
drafts.note: Correct facts, so both gates approve; the best-option check shows it leaves the customer $88.20/yr worse off.

drafts.text: As a customer of more than 12 months, you qualify for our 15% loyalty discount, which brings Pro to $41.65 per month.
If you switch to annual billing, Pro drops to $39.20 per month, billed once a year.
I can combine your loyalty discount with annual billing for 35% off.
Incredible deal!!! Go annual and Pro is just $39.20 a month. You'll love it, guaranteed!
I'll waive this month's fee and make an exception on the loyalty discount for you.
No need to worry about deletion requests: the GDPR only applies to companies headquartered in the EU, and we're based in the US.

drafts.note: Ezio flags the tone (critical) but its overall tier stays GREEN, so the starter approves; the gate finds the wrong discount.
drafts.text: WOW!!! As one of our most loyal customers you get 30% OFF, locked in, GUARANTEED!!!

drafts.note: The calm rewrite: Ezio is clean, the starter approves, and the loyalty discount is still 15%, not 30%.
drafts.text: As a loyal customer, you get 30% off your Pro plan.
